judge.method: self-judged visual inspection of the Chrome render; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a recognizable grey dolphin with a streamlined body, dorsal fin, and tail fluke.
requirements.note: The recognizable streamlined dolphin has a dorsal fin and tail fluke, but it is teal-blue rather than grey.

requirements.text: Show a water surface below the dolphin with a large splash effect at the point where the dolphin has exited the water.
requirements.note: A water surface and prominent white splash appear beneath the dolphin's tail.

requirements.text: Position the dolphin in a dynamic jumping arc, with its entire body in mid-air.
requirements.note: The tail and lower body visibly overlap the water surface, so the entire body is not in mid-air.

requirements.text: Draw a circular, multi-colored hula hoop, and position the dolphin so its mid-section is passing through the center of the hoop.
requirements.note: The multi-colored circular hoop visibly passes around the dolphin's mid-section.

requirements.text: Include a human trainer's arm and hand extending into the frame.
requirements.note: A trainer's arm and hand extend into the frame from the right.

requirements.text: The trainer's hand must be holding a small fish by the tail.
requirements.note: The trainer visibly holds the small fish by its tail.

requirements.text: The dolphin's mouth must be depicted as wide open, just about to bite the body of the fish being held by the trainer.
requirements.note: The visibly open mouth is immediately beside the fish body held by the trainer.
